findings: The public calibration seam is one body-curried Normalizer over arbitrary observation types; it contains no device taxonomy, temporal history, motor identity, direction, or evaluator target.

Signal mapping preserves physical origin and sample-versus-transition incidence, while unavailable component observations and unavailable body context remain unavailable rather than receiving invented defaults.
Residual has a lawful zero identity, associative saturating composition, identity effect at zero, and an ordinary effect opportunity only when positive.
Scalar finger, five local finger factors, binocular offsets, acoustic availability, structured vocal spectrum, mixed value types, and a held-out spatial field all use the unchanged transformation.

Attached residual tissue separates persistent Sample drive, action-caused rise, action-caused fall, and zero identity. Same-or-larger residual writes no new consequence; a smaller residual closes before renewed drive.
The complete runtime composition regulates both disturbance signs after motor reflection and body-context shift, preserves real action origins, replays exactly, and naturally quiesces.
All affected core and embodiment tests pass, and the independently timed warm regression is 1.33 seconds, below the strict ten-second limit.
residual_uncertainty: The physical regulation evidence is a bounded scalar morphology after arbitrary typed observations have been reduced to Residual; it does not establish real finger, hand, eye, ear, vocal, speech, multisensor, or arbitrary-morphology competence.
Body relations are caller-supplied pure functions. This campaign does not establish how an organism develops or revises those relations, nor does it authorize evaluator-defined goals as body context.
Necessity is not yet frozen: body currying, persistent drive, rise/fall separation, and zero identity still require the declared downward ablations before the next real morphology.
The worktree is intentionally dirty with prior development, so this is content-addressed candidate evidence and not a clean authority or default-protocol promotion.
